en: The postcard shows a tall concrete television tower with multiple circular observation and equipment decks, some highlighted by red bands, rising above a densely wooded hillside with autumn-colored trees under a blue sky with clouds. The reverse side is a standard divided postcard layout with multilingual captions identifying the site as a television tower in the Mecsek hills near Pécs, Hungary, plus publisher and price information.
